svg.title: UltrafuzzBench quality
svg.desc: Macro precision, recall, and F1 over complete benchmark target cohorts for the latest 12 candidate runs. Lines break when the cohort, execution policy, or scoring identity changes. Marker shapes distinguish model profiles.
svg.text: Each point aggregates every required target; incomplete cohorts are omitted and incompatible lineages are not connected.
